auth_note: The CDX/collection index answered an anonymous request with 200; bulk data over HTTPS needs no AWS account.
bulk_access: https://data.commoncrawl.org/ (HTTPS), s3://commoncrawl/ (authenticated S3 API only); Columnar Index recommended for bulk
probe_observation: collinfo.json returned 200 with a JSON array of crawl entries starting with id CC-MAIN-2026-39 and its cdx-api URL.

evidence.quote: There is no need to create an AWS account in order to access the data using this method.
Crawl data is free to access by anyone from anywhere.
The data is accessible via the https://data.commoncrawl.org/[...] URL scheme.
Please do not overload the URL index server. For bulk downloads (e.g. all records of the entire .com top-level domain), see the download instructions .

not_established: No numeric rate limit is documented (only 'do not overload the URL index server'). No data license stated: Terms of Use say Crawled Content may be subject to the separate terms of its owners, no CC0/CC-BY-style grant was found in docs, terms, FAQ or index page.
